notes: Koning, Hasan, Chatterji (2022, MS) Table 2 col 3: reghdfe log1p_pageviews using_ab_only, absorb(week_id firm_id) vce(cluster firm_id) on ab_data.dta (35,262 firms x 208 weeks, balanced, N=7,334,496). fixest on the package data reproduces 0.5535 (0.0259) exactly. Treatment is NOT absorbing: 4,143 of 6,144 ever-users switch off at least once; run_spec.R's Hull fn 6 rule drops 385,098 post-adoption firm-weeks with using_ab_only = 0, so its TWFE (0.7205, SE 0.0307, N 6,949,375; 0.194 SD) differs by construction from the published 0.553 (0.148 SD). 2,732 firms are already treated in week 1 (always-treated) and 206 distinct first-adoption weeks occur after week 1; 29,118 firms never treated. Published coefficient taken from the Harvard DASH author manuscript via the screening record; the project text file is the 2019 NBER WP (173 weeks, coef 0.464).
